home.hero_headline: Senior Project Management for complex international delivery environments.
home.hero_subline: Structured project leadership for setup, stabilization and optimization.
home.statement: I step into projects when things are complex, critical or unclear.
home.challenges_headline: When projects need structure and reliable execution.
home.challenges_subline: I support organizations when project environments become complex, critical or unclear.

challenges.name: Project Stabilization
challenges.desc: A project requires clearer priorities, stronger governance and reliable execution.

challenges.name: Scalable Delivery
challenges.desc: Existing delivery structures no longer support the required scope or growth.

challenges.name: International Coordination
challenges.desc: Distributed teams and stakeholders need stronger alignment and communication.

challenges.name: Shoring
challenges.desc: Nearshore or offshore structures need to be established, transitioned or improved.

challenges.name: Governance and Transparency
challenges.desc: Financials, risks, responsibilities and delivery status are not sufficiently transparent.

challenges.name: Transition and Recovery
challenges.desc: A project, supplier or delivery organization must be transferred or stabilized.

home.establish_text: I set up clear project structures, responsibilities, governance and communication from the start — creating the foundation that complex projects need to move forward.
home.stabilize_text: I establish priorities, improve delivery reliability and create transparency across finances, risks and stakeholders — turning critical situations into controlled delivery.
home.optimize_text: I improve delivery models, shoring structures, scalability and opportunities for automation — building delivery environments that sustain performance long-term.
home.evidence_headline: Projects that required more than standard delivery.
home.evidence_subline: Each engagement had a specific reason it was complex, critical or unclear. Here is what was done.
home.services_subline: Depending on what your situation requires — operational leadership, external advice, or structured support for your project managers.
home.pm_preview_desc: Operational responsibility for project setup, transition, recovery and delivery. I lead the project.
home.consulting_preview_desc: Structured analysis and recommendations for delivery models, shoring, risk management and project controlling. I assess and advise.
home.coaching_preview_desc: Practical, experience-based sparring for project managers and delivery leads in demanding situations. I develop people.

profile.ep_lead: I step into projects when things are complex, critical or unclear.
profile.ep_p1: With more than 20 years of experience in project, transition and program management, I support organizations in stabilizing delivery, managing transitions and setting up projects for success.
profile.ep_p2: My focus is on creating clarity, aligning stakeholders and bringing structure into challenging environments. I typically lead mid-sized teams in multinational and distributed setups.
profile.ep_p3: I work hands-on, structured and pragmatic, with a strong focus on operational excellence. This means clear targets, transparent communication and creating the space for teams to take ownership and perform.
profile.industries_automotive: Software delivery, connected services, infotainment, test management and PLM.
profile.industries_telco: Service management, CRM, campaign management, data analytics and digital services.
profile.industries_banking: CRM, analytical systems, campaign management and business intelligence.
profile.industries_engineering: Engineering services and consulting organizations, from mid-sized companies to global enterprises.
profile.industries_international: Project delivery across Europe, China and India — including distributed teams, nearshore structures and cross-border transitions.
profile.hw_p1: I work in a professional, structured and pragmatic way. I create clarity through transparent communication, clear responsibilities and reliable project governance.
profile.hw_p2: My leadership style is calm and collaborative. I involve relevant stakeholders, base decisions on facts and provide teams with clear direction while creating space for ownership.
profile.hw_p3: In critical situations, I focus on stabilizing delivery, establishing priorities and maintaining controlled execution.
profile.tagline: Successful projects are built on transparency, structured execution and trustful collaboration.

services.intro: My services combine operational project responsibility with structured consulting and experience-based support for project managers and delivery leads.
services.pm_when: Project setup, transition, recovery, international delivery or operational stabilization require experienced project leadership.
services.pm_value: Structured execution, improved transparency and reliable project delivery.
services.consulting_when: Organizations need an experienced external perspective on their project setup, delivery structures or operational performance.
services.consulting_value: A clear decision basis and an applicable approach for improving delivery and project performance.
services.coaching_when: Project managers and delivery leads face demanding situations or want to develop their capabilities through practical, experience-based support.
services.coaching_value: Greater clarity, confidence and effectiveness in managing complex projects.
